- Completed vendor profile form (received)

- Vendor records: legal name on the W-9 becomes the canonical vendor master name. If you operate under a different remit name, note that in the profile.

I'll attach our vendor intake checklist for your convenience. Karthik — once you've reviewed, can you confirm any additional PO metadata we should request from VendorCorp?
